title: When do two populations form two clusters?
description: Two simulated populations of 100 people each. The sliders set how far the populations have drifted apart (Fst) and how many variants are used. The plot shows PC1 and PC2. The two populations separate on PC1 only when the drift and the number of variants are large enough.

stats.label: Separation of A and B on PC1 (0 = none, above 3 = clear)
